### The Name of the Game Is Change
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/article-library/individual/the-name-of-the-game-is-change
Passage: Jeremiah 13:23
Points:
- Sinful habits become deeply ingrained and feel like second nature over time.
- People frequently invent excuses to protect their comfort in long-practiced faults.
- Confronting and putting to death our sinful nature requires painful, deliberate effort.
- Meaningful spiritual growth occurs gradually through daily discipline rather than overnight fixes.
- Scripture is given not merely to satisfy curiosity, but to transform our lives.
